newsitem.title: UK: P&O shares down ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: P&O shares down ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular & Oriental Steam Nagivation Co Plc dropped in early trade on Monday after negative press comment ahead of its year-emd results on Tuesday.
The stock was down 9-1/2p at 624 by 0831 GMT in thin volume of 2,644 shares.
A report in the Financial Times said P&O was likely to deliver limited news of progress on its planned one billion stg disposal programme, announced last March.
The paper added that P&O's cargo operations were likely to come under further pressure after news last week that Nedlloyd profits had been squeezed by low margins in container shipping.

It also said the planned merger of its ferry operations with Stena faced delays because of conditions imposed by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission, which was likely to recommend continued competition in freight.
Separately a report in the Observer newspaper said P&O had been forced to delay the flotation of housebuilder Bovis and drop plans to sell its bulk shipping arm.
No one at the company was immediately available for comment.
